entities.summary: Mary Jo Kilroy is an American attorney and politician who served as the U.S. representative for Ohio's 15th congressional district from 2009 until 2011. She is a member of the Democratic Party from Ohio. She was defeated in her November 2, 2010 re-election bid. In 2012, she ran in the newly redrawn, Columbus-based 3rd congressional district but lost in the primary. Mary Jo Kilroy was a legal figures from Cleveland (b. 1949-04-30, Cleveland). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
